content:
**Dodgy** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased Evade chance. Evade no longer has a cooldown; instead, it costs AP. The AP cost is equal to 30x the cooldown time. If there's not enough AP to pay for the Evade, the Evade does not occur.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | +5% chance to Evade. Evade no longer has a cooldown. Instead it costs AP. | 003D2948 | 

Before update 60, the perk reduced incoming damage by 10%/20%/30% at the cost of 30 AP.
